title: Velo Tropical Ice Mini Nicotine Pouches - Mellow (6mg)
description: Velo Mini Tropical Ice Nicotine Pouches blend exotic Pineapple, creamy Coconut, juicy Mango and ripe Papaya, rounded off with a cooling edge for a flavour that tastes fruity, bright and refreshing. The mix of tropical fruit and a cool finish makes Tropical Ice a memorable option in the Mini collection. Each can contains 15 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is delivered steadily without smoke, vapour or odour, offering convenience wherever you are. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide range of flavours and strengths. Velo Mini cans contain 15 pouches and are designed for those who prefer a smaller format with a Mellow 6mg nicotine strength. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
